What is rustdesk?

RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop app that lets you view and control another computer over the internet or a local network, similar to TeamViewer or AnyDesk. It works out of the box using RustDesk's public relay servers, or you can self-host your own rendezvous/relay server for full privacy and control. A paid RustDesk Server Pro edition adds enterprise features like address books, audit logs, and easier deployment for teams.

Install rustdesk on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add rustdesk

Good to know

  • Network access between the two machines (via RustDesk's relay or your own self-hosted server)
